Thanks for the ping — I support this. DevCommunity is a solid fit for our developer outreach and the subscriber sample looks high-quality. A couple of notes:

- Budget: We can approve a small promo allowance under the "newsletter partner" bucket up to $2,400 (target unit economics: $12 CPA equivalent).
- Offer design: 30-day trial with a $100 credit cap should be fine; that prevents long-running accounts from burning budget.
- Fulfillment: Serialized codes give better attribution but require ops touch. Single redeem link + per-email enforcement is faster and low-touch; we should prefer link if they can pass an identifier (email) on redemption.

Ben, can you confirm whether a single redeem link can be rate-limited / one-per-email? If not, we'll generate 200 serialized codes and route ops to drop them into their template.

I'll draft suggested blurb for the newsletter once we confirm redemption approach.

Marissa

Director, Growth Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwoodai.com

Apologies for the short delay — ops can support both options. Quick summary of tradeoffs and what I pushed live:

- Single redeem link: We can create a time-limited link that enforces one redemption per email address (via verification flow) and auto-applies the 30-day, $100 credit cap. This is the least operational overhead.
- Serialized codes: We can generate 200 unique codes (CSV attached) if they insist on embedding codes in the email. That requires them to map codes to recipients or distribute without mapping (higher risk of sharing).

I generated the single redeem link and a test payload. Link: https://redwood.ai/redeem/partners/DC-2026-089 (expires 2026-02-22)
Redemption terms: 30 days free or $100 credit cap, one redemption per email enforced by tokenized flow.

Attachments: partner-redeem-codes.csv (only present if we go serialized)

Marissa — attaching a suggested one-line blurb below for insertion; feel free to edit.

Blurb (50–70 chars): Try Redwood Inference free for 30 days — exclusive devcommunity access. Redeem at: https://redwood.ai/redeem/partners/DC-2026-089

If this is good, Dylan please confirm and I'll mark the HubSpot deal and close the loop with DevCommunity.

Ben Carter
Growth Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
